title: PHILIPS TAH4050 Wireless Bluetooth Headphones with Mic, 40mm Dynamic Drivers, Bluetooth 6.0, Up to 30H Playtime, Dual Device Pairing, USB-C Fast Charging, AUX Support, Over-Ear Headset, Black
bullets: IMMERSIVE 40MM DYNAMIC SOUND DRIVERS – Experience rich bass, clear vocals, and balanced audio with powerful 40mm dynamic drivers and a 20Hz–20kHz frequency range, making these wireless headphones ideal for music, movies, podcasts, and gaming.

UP TO 30 HOURS PLAYTIME & FAST USB-C CHARGING – Enjoy uninterrupted listening with up to 30 hours of battery life on a single charge. Recharge quickly in just 1.5–2 hours using the included USB-C charging cable.

BLUETOOTH 6.0 WITH DUAL DEVICE PAIRING – Equipped with the latest Bluetooth 6.0 technology for stable wireless connectivity up to 10 meters. Dual pairing allows seamless switching between your smartphone, laptop, tablet, or other Bluetooth devices.

HANDS-FREE CALLING WITH BUILT-IN MICROPHONE – Stay connected on the go with the integrated microphone and hands-free calling support. Perfect for online meetings, work calls, video chats, and everyday communication.

WIRELESS & WIRED LISTENING OPTIONS – Use wirelessly via Bluetooth or connect with the included AUX cable for uninterrupted audio. Easy button controls provide convenient access to music playback, volume adjustment, and call management.
